Job Summary:**

The Assistant Head of Serology will support the Serology Section Head in managing and overseeing serological (HI & ELISA) testing operations within PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk, ensuring accurate and timely results for disease surveillance and control in poultry health.

Job Responsibilities:**.

* Assist the Head of in planning, organizing, and directing daily serology laboratory activities.

* Supervise and train junior laboratory technicians on serological testing procedures, including ELISA, agglutination, and other relevant assays.

* Ensure adherence to established laboratory protocols, quality control standards, and biosafety guidelines.

* Oversee the maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment, troubleshoot issues, and ensure proper functioning.

* Participate in the development and validation of new serological testing methods and improve existing ones.

* Analyze and interpret serological data, prepare reports, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

* Manage inventory of reagents, consumables, and laboratory supplies, ensuring adequate stock levels.

* Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of a robust Quality Management System (ISO/IEC 17025-2017) within the serology section.

* Assist in research and development initiatives related to animal health diagnostics.

* Ensure accurate record-keeping and data management for all serological tests performed.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine (S-1), Fresh graduate

* Proven experience with various serological techniques, including ELISA, HI, AGPT, and other relevant assays, mycotoxin test

* Strong understanding of laboratory quality control and assurance principles.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to supervise and mentor a team of laboratory technicians.

* Proficiency in data analysis and report generation.

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

* Familiarity with relevant biosafety regulations and practices.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
